_comment: A well-run, least-privilege project. A read-only human (roles/viewer) and one service account that may only read one bucket. This is the 'nothing to see here' baseline — very few permissions are reachable, so every scan is instant.
_expect: blindspots  ->  finishes in well under a second; almost every permission is 'unreachable' (nobody holds it). This is the FAST path — contrast with the owner account.

blindspots storage.objects.get  ->  reachable + (data-access logging is on) logged; whether it's a gap depends on the rules you loaded. With no rules loaded, it's an unobserved event (a gap by default).
name: least-privilege
